title: Implement event queue system
description: Create python/src/lichen/sim/events.py. Priority queue sorted by time. Event base class with time field. Subclasses: TxStartEvent, TxEndEvent, RxTimeoutEvent. EventQueue class: push(event), pop() -> Event, peek() -> Event | None, is_empty() -> bool. All times in microseconds (int). Unit tests for ordering, ties broken by insertion order.
notes: Validated and completed 2026-08-27. Event.__post_init__ now rejects non-exact-integer time_us values (including bool) and negative simulation timestamps. EventQueue preserves insertion-order FIFO among ordinary equal-time events, including TxStartEvent, TxEndEvent, and RxTimeoutEvent, while retaining the newer DelayedRxReadyEvent same-tick precedence required by RX barrier semantics. Existing TxStart/TxEnd/RxTimeout field and empty peek/pop tests remain passing; added focused timestamp and cross-type tie regressions. Mechanically moved existing late test imports to satisfy focused lint. Verification from python/: uv run pytest tests/sim/test_events.py -q => 53 passed; uv run ruff check src/lichen/sim/events.py tests/sim/test_events.py => All checks passed; git diff --check passed.
close_reason: Event queue ordering, event fields, empty semantics, and integer-microsecond validation implemented and verified; 53 focused tests pass and Ruff is clean.
